siteRules.title: Forced per-site rules
siteRules.description: Rules that outrank the user's site policy. pattern: host, *.host, a host glob like *bank*, optionally with a path prefix (github.com/settings). rule: blocked, read-only, ask, or trusted.

disableDevTools.title: Disable developer tools
disableDevTools.description: Refuse every developer-tools call (inspection, page JavaScript, network capture) and keep the setting off.

disableUnrestricted.title: Disable unrestricted access
disableUnrestricted.description: The user cannot trust every site at once; every call follows the ordinary approval flow.

enforceSiteDefaults.title: Enforce built-in site defaults
enforceSiteDefaults.description: The built-in read-only rules for banking, password managers, identity providers, and cloud consoles cannot be turned off.

disableLocalTaintExemption.title: Treat local pages as untrusted content
disableLocalTaintExemption.description: Pages served from this machine (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]) restrict a session like any other page; the user cannot turn that off.

disableTrustedTaintExemption.title: Treat trusted sites as untrusted content
disableTrustedTaintExemption.description: Pages from sites the user marked trusted restrict a session like any other page; the user cannot turn that off.

disableAutoReview.title: Disable Auto approve
disableAutoReview.description: Auto approve (the agent acting without approval cards, with consequential steps checked by the conversation's model) is not offered; every card goes to the user.

allowedOrigins.title: Allowed web origins
allowedOrigins.description: When set, the agent may read, act on, and navigate to only these origins (https://app.example.com or *.example.com).
